description: A comprehensive test script for Lua interpreter features, including environment variables, command-line options, error handling, warnings, file operations, and signal handling.

methods.name: prepfile
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a file with specified content, optionally in binary mode.

methods.name: getoutput
methods.description: Reads content from a temporary output file and deletes it.

methods.name: checkprogout
methods.description: Verifies that the output matches expected lines.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Checks that the output matches expected output.

methods.name: RUN
methods.description: Executes a command with Lua interpreter, replacing 'lua' with the program name.

methods.name: NoRun
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail with specific error message.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Sends an interrupt signal to a process by PID.

methods.name: runback
methods.description: Runs a Lua script in background, returning its output file handle and PID.
